field.label: Enable Ladon
field.help: Run the Ladon split-routing engine and load the Unbound DNS hook.

field.label: Probe mode
field.help: local: gateway-side probe only. exit-compare: also validate blocks against a remote prober (needs a clean exit).

field.label: Remote prober URL
field.help: exit-compare only. HTTP endpoint of the remote prober.

field.label: Remote prober token
field.help: exit-compare only. Sent as the prober auth value.

field.label: Route presets
field.help: Bundled allow-lists to always send through the tunnel.

field.label: Promote threshold
field.help: Blocked verdicts within the scorer window before a domain is cached durably.

field.label: Hot TTL
field.help: How long a one-off detected block stays tunneled.

field.label: Manual allow
field.help: One domain or CIDR per line — always tunneled.

field.label: Manual deny
field.help: One domain per line — never tracked or tunneled.

field.label: Deny presets
field.help: Bundled deny-lists (same pool as route presets; a name cannot be in both).

field.label: Family confirm threshold
field.help: Confirmed members of an eTLD+1 before the whole family (CDN) is trusted and expanded.

field.label: Ignore client IP
field.help: Client IP whose queries to skip (the gateway), default 10.10.0.1. Leave empty for that default. Do not use 127.0.0.1: the OPNsense DNS hook reports that placeholder as the client, so it would mute all observations.
